backend/main.mo: Defines the backend canister with all core domain types for patients, labs, medications, ADRs, prescriber-related data, drug interactions, and storage mixins.
backend/migration.mo: Provides a no-op migration module that preserves old prescriber and user profile maps without modification.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping feature requirements to affected frontend files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains prewritten summaries of multiple frontend files describing UI behaviors, data flow, and optimizations.
frontend/.env.local: Local development environment variables for canister IDs, host, and dev server settings.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML entry point that loads the React application root and main script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app component handling authentication flow, profile loading behavior, and conditional rendering of dashboard and modals.
frontend/src/backend.idl.ts: IDL definitions mapping backend Motoko types to TypeScript for agent communication.
frontend/src/components/AddPatientDialog: Dialog component for adding a patient with validated form fields and BMI calculation.
frontend/src/components/AdrForm.tsx: Form for recording an adverse drug reaction and submitting it via mutation.
frontend/src/components/AdrsModule.tsx: Module displaying patient info and tabs for entering or listing ADRs.
Empty component file with no implementation.
frontend/src/components/CaseEntry.tsx: Main case entry interface with tabs for labs, medications, ADRs, prescriber details, and summary.
frontend/src/components/CaseNarrationSec: Empty component file with no implementation.
frontend/src/components/CaseSummary.tsx: Generates a full clinical summary by aggregating labs, medications, ADRs, and prescriber data for a patient.
frontend/src/components/DisclaimersSecti: Displays static application disclaimers with icons inside a styled card.
frontend/src/components/DrugDetailsModal: Displays detailed drug info in a modal with fallbacks and source/status indicators.
frontend/src/components/DrugDrugInteract: Searches and displays drug interaction data, drug details, and monograph lookup with tab navigation.
frontend/src/components/DrugInteractions: Checks multi-drug, drug-food, and food-food interactions and presents results with severity and toxicity indicators.
frontend/src/components/DrugMonographSec: Renders drug monograph sections such as pharmacokinetics with graceful fallbacks when data is missing.
Shows a searchable, filterable drug table with status tabs, sync info, and a modal for detailed viewing.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Displays the site footer with branding and a disclaimer.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Shows the header with logo, user profile info, and logout handling.
frontend/src/components/NameAutocomplete: Autocomplete input with filtered suggestions, keyboard navigation, and click-outside handling.
frontend/src/components/PatientDetailsDi: Dialog showing detailed patient info including labs, medications, and ADRs with memoized cards and query data.
frontend/src/components/PatientManagemen: Main patient list UI with add, view, select, and delete actions using memoized rows and query hooks.
frontend/src/components/PrescriberDetail: Form to view, edit, validate, and save prescriber details tied to a patient.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal for entering and saving basic user profile details before accessing the dashboard.
frontend/src/components/RestrictedDrugsM: Searchable, categorized restricted-drugs viewer with collapsible sections and external resource links.
frontend/src/components/StartupProfileRe: UI banner component that warns about delayed profile loading and provides retry and logout actions, invalidating related queries before retrying.
frontend/src/components/WavebotWidget.ts: Interactive chat-style widget with local resource definitions and messaging logic, using patient and lab result query hooks.
frontend/src/data/curatedDrugDataset.ts: Utilities for normalizing and deduplicating drug names plus a large curated dataset of approved and banned drugs with metadata.
frontend/src/data/drugFoodInteractionsDa: Expanded dataset describing drug–food interactions with evidence levels, clinical effects, and management guidance.
frontend/src/data/drugInteractionExample: Preset drug interaction example sets with helper functions to load and validate them.
Comprehensive drug monograph dataset including pharmacokinetics, side effects, contraindications, and special population info.
frontend/src/data/foodFoodInteractionsDa: Defines a typed dataset of food–food interactions with descriptions, severity, clinical effects, recommendations, and references.
frontend/src/data/foodList.ts: Exports a canonical list of food names and a helper to retrieve them for autocomplete and lookup.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user’s Internet Identity and invalidates dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity auth management, exposing identity state, login, logout, and context provider logic.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for patients, labs, medications, and other backend data using the authenticated actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind-based global styles, light/dark color variables, and performance‑optimized utility classes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Implements the main dashboard with tabbed modules, lazy‑loaded components, prefetching, and patient selection state.
frontend/src/services/cdscoDrugService.t: Simulates CDSCO banned-drug data fetching with caching and returns sample drug entries.
frontend/src/services/drugDrugInteractio: Manages drug interaction database with caching, defaults, and detailed interaction structures.
frontend/src/services/drugInteractionInd: Builds and caches a normalized interaction index for fast O(1) drug-pair lookups.
frontend/src/services/drugInteractionVer: Handles live verification of interactions via MIMS/Toaz with caching, syncing, and scheduled updates.
frontend/src/services/drugMonographServi: Resolves drug names to monographs using normalized lookup with a cached index.
frontend/src/services/foodInteractionInd: Builds and caches normalized drug‑food and food‑food interaction indexes with lookup utilities.
frontend/src/services/interactionNameCat: Generates canonical drug/food name lists and filters suggestions using normalization.
frontend/src/services/multiSourceDrugSer: Manages multi‑source drug data with caching, deterministic merging, and scheduled/background sync. Handles storage versioning, progress callbacks, and error‑tolerant dataset aggregation.
frontend/src/utils/drugPairs.ts: Provides helpers to normalize drug names and generate, compare, and label unique drug pairs. Ensures consistent pair keys and user‑friendly formatting.
frontend/src/utils/interactionSummary.ts: Computes overall interaction summaries from pairwise data, determining highest severity, toxicity risk, and recommendations. Includes display formatting for severity and toxicity values.
frontend/src/utils/nameNormalization.ts: Normalizes names by stripping punctuation/spacing and detects equivalence or duplicates. Used for consistent matching of drug or food names.
frontend/src/utils/namePairs.ts: Generates deterministic unique name pairs and formats pair labels for display. Filters out empty or invalid names before pairing.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining theme colors, typography, container settings, and plugins. Extends palette using OKLCH-based custom color variables.
project_state.json: Describes current project state, tracked features, versions, and requirements related to prescriber details and drug database updates.
